text: Can you put together every open or recent ticket and feature request on Marrow Agrisupply and Marrow Fieldworks? Pull from our team channels and Moss's Central notes, and label each one by account. I need the list for the Marrow review on Thursday.
reply_text:

If you want current status, I can check with Priyanka and Moss, or pull the CRM ticket records if you can get me access to those folders.
